target: PHP 8.5.10 CLI NTS 64-bit, pinned -n profile with include_path=.: and LC_ALL=C
status: Private candidate on final installed typed-return base; independent current-base replay, canonical integration and installed checks pending
contract: Snapshot v2 keys include resolution facts by exact caller filename, requested bytes, captured CWD and captured include_path. File contexts retain historical lookup provenance while the live globals may change. Source-callable set_include_path, ini_set of exact include_path, and ini_restore mutate only the authored INI state after argument binding. chdir pauses after scalar/path validation for a one-shot finite OS fact keyed by converted requested bytes and current CWD; success changes global CWD, failure emits the authored errno warning and returns false. Neither adapter nor parser executes PHP or changes host CWD. Once membership remains keyed by canonical opened path.
chdir_fact_basis: The source harness creates finite directories and obtains success next-CWD bytes from Path.resolve. Failure facts use errno.ENOENT and os.strerror under LC_ALL=C. The requested bytes, canonical next path, errno and warning text are explicit snapshot input and are checked against pinned native raw stdout, stderr and exit; no warning or directory result is copied from the model.
source_domain: 28 exact native comparisons: include_path mutation, direct/named/unpacked/first-class intrinsics, relative and absolute chdir, include-once after CWD change, chdir within an included function, ENOENT/empty/null/NUL, weak and strict integer operands. The full 28-row report is current for the private code tree, not complete-core coverage.
non_numeric_checks: Explicit private adapter and numeric-runner Dune builds, SpecTec elaboration, Python compilation and git diff --check passed. New and retained report manifests bind the local binaries and source modules; source and new protocol reports also record vendored PHP-Parser tree identity.
remaining: Dynamic ownerless intrinsic selection remains fail-closed Unsupported pending an authenticated selected-call binding. Stringable chdir operands, other INI options, mutable error-handler warning effects, other OS failure classes and stream wrappers need separate exact source/provider checks. The finite snapshot remains explicit input; this is not general host filesystem execution or complete PHP semantics.
